metadata.title: Levenshtein-type bounds for $(a,b)$-avoiding spherical codes
metadata.abstract: We develop a Levenshtein-type linear programming framework (for maximal $s$-codes and for minimal energy) for $(a,b)$-avoiding spherical codes, that is, codes whose inner products between distinct points avoid $(a,b)$. We introduce and investigate signed measures that are positive definite up to an appropriate degree and yield stationary auxiliary linear programming polynomials and exact quadrature formulas. We give explicit conditions for positivity of the quadrature weights and sufficient Krein-type conditions for nonnegative Gegenbauer coefficients (positive definiteness of the candidate optimal linear programming polynomials). Under these hypotheses and suitable node-location assumptions, the resulting cardinality bounds are optimal within the corresponding degree restriction and unique under natural nondegeneracy conditions. Under proper conditions on the quadrature nodes, we obtain universal lower energy bounds by utilizing Hermite interpolants as polynomial solutions of the respective linear program. Common test functions characterize optimality in the full polynomial linear programs under mild additional assumptions.

analysis.progressType: 禁内积区间球面码的线性规划框架
analysis.workSummary: 对点对内积避开(a,b)的球面码，建立最大s码与最小能量的Levenshtein型线性规划方法。构造有限次数正定的有符号测度，给出驻定辅助多项式和精确求积。
techniques: 有符号测度与有限阶正定性
analysis.breakthrough: 在权重、节点位置及Krein条件下得到相应次数限制内最优的基数界，适当非退化时唯一。另用插值得普适能量下界，并以测试函数判别完整多项式规划最优性。
analysis.limitations: 不同最优性结论各有正性、节点和非退化条件；次数内最优与完整规划最优需区分。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
